s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Amaravati educational and cultural academy at Abburaajupalem?

Fisheries development boards are at Vijayawada and Bhimavaram

s: Where is the Sustainable Textile Recycling Unit (₹4,200 crore, with a Fabindia marketing tie-up) proposed?

o: To promote rainwater harvesting in Gram Panchayats
To tackle declining birth rate and ageing
To support women entrepreneurs through business loans
To provide training for transgender persons

s: In which year was the national e-Sanjeevani telemedicine programme launched?

The Sanjeevani technical committee has 14 members.

s:

o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A

Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas
Mission for Empowerment of Poor in Metropolitan Areas

s: Where was the Sanjeevani AI-based digital health project of Andhra Pradesh piloted?

A modernised fair price shop network

s: Where was the first Mee Mart outlet opened?

s: Which platform tracks more than 800 urban water supply and sewerage projects across all 123 Urban Local Bodies in Andhra Pradesh?

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NiVU AI's tourism rollout in Andhra Pradesh?

It will cover more than 100 destinations within two years
It offers QR-code access without an app and support in 130+ languages
It is linked to Swarna Andhra Vision-2047
x: NiVU AI is to cover more than 100 destinations within three years, not two.

s: With which organisation has the AP Civil Supplies Department partnered for Mee Mart?

s: Into what does Mee Mart in Andhra Pradesh modernise fair price shops?

s: Under which body does Kalyana Lakshmi, which gives low-interest loans for marriage expenses of SHG families, run?

s: What does OWMS monitor in Andhra Pradesh?

s: What is the purpose of the e-Suvidha project in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Monitoring of urban water supply works
x: e-Suvidha computerises Urban Local Bodies (online payments, certificates, municipal services); OWMS monitors works and Mee Mart modernises ration shops.
